notes:
Lead origin: inbound self-serve signup (free credits used). Early discovery call 2026-02-25.

Background:
- Small developer tools startup building an in-app chat assistant for their web IDE.
- Using hosted API (public cloud) — likes low friction and streaming.
- Goal: rich structured responses + tool-calling for code execution and diagnostics.

Pain points described on call:
- 'When we switch to JSON mode we sometimes get partial JSON chunks and parser fails on client' — customer sees trailing commas or cut-off arrays mid-stream.
- Function-calling schema: model returns unexpected keys and nested types (e.g., "args": "{\"file\": 123}" instead of object), causing our function dispatcher to >=error out.
- Streaming boundaries: their client expects one JSON per message but model emits multiple small JSON fragments that must be concatenated and validated.
- SDK mismatch suspicion: they upgraded frontend SDK two weeks ago; issues started after that.

Troubleshooting so far:
- 2026-02-26: AE/Ethan triaged with quick reproduction steps; customer provided short prompt and failing transcript.
- 2026-02-27: SE Ravi validated reproduction locally with hosted_api streaming endpoint; reproduced partial chunk + parse exception. Logged INF-1223.
- 2026-02-28: Provided interim guidance: enable "json_mode": "strict", increase stream buffer timeout, and post-process concatenation strategy; customer tried but still sees edge cases where chunks split inside escape sequences.
- 2026-03-01: Recorded Fireflies call (ff_2026_03_01_1543) where customer shared error logs and sample transcripts.

Requirements / priorities (customer language):
- Latency target: 200-400ms per token perceived in-chat.
- Throughput: small concurrent user base (~10-30 concurrent sessions).
- Cost sensitivity: SMB; wants predictable per-token cost; open to batching suggestions if not impacting perceived latency.
- Security: SSO for admin console, SOC2 expected for vendor. Data residency not critical (US customers).
- Must have structured output and reliable function-calling for in-app automated code run triggers.

Technical notes from SE (Ravi):
- Repro shows model emits broken JSON when stop sequence occurs mid-object on chunk boundary. Client-side parser fails since it expects complete JSON per chunk.
- Two mitigation paths: 1) server-side streaming reassembly + schema-aware incremental validation; 2) prefer function-calling mode (native structured outputs) and ensure schema strictness.
- Observed that in current hosted setup model variant responds with both text and function payloads in same stream occasionally; need to force function-only outputs via parameters.

Proposed next steps (short):
- 1) 60m call with customer + Ravi + infra engineer to capture exact SDK versions, headers, and sample transcripts (Ethan to send invite).
- 2) Customer to drop minimal repro repo (branch) showing client parser and exact failure case.
- 3) SE to provide short config patch: set streaming_chunk_merge=true, json_mode=strict, function_schema_enforce=true, and recommended SDK pin.
- 4) If POC still fails, open high-priority infra trace and request model-side streaming consistency checks (INF-1223).
